name: dsh-endurance-coach
description: Endurance Coach (耐力教练) — an endurance-coaching skill for DeepSeek Harness. COROS is the primary source for runs, rides, plans, sleep and recovery; iGPSPORT supplements cycling (thresholds, segments, history); Intervals.icu provides combined training load. Turns that data into daily decisions, weekly plans, race prep and reviews.
